method: All Meteora Lock escrows created by the DBC pool authority (FhVo3m…HLuM), i.e. every DBC team allocation. Vested is computed at chain time. "Moved" = claimed minus what the recipient wallet still holds in its token account for that mint: a lower bound on what was sold or sent elsewhere. Market: the most liquid pair on DexScreener at generation time (null = no pair listed).
